dependency_notes: S1 must precede S2 (S2 consumes FailedWelcomesAPI exported by S1: loadFailedWelcomes, forgetFailedWelcome, appendFailedWelcome, pruneOlderThan, notestr:failed-welcomes-changed DOM event). S4 also consumes loadFailedWelcomes from S1 and must be implemented after S1. S3, S5, S6 are fully independent of each other and of S1/S2. Suggested execution order: S5 (mechanical single-line fix), S6 (wires existing primitive), S1 (data layer foundation), S3 (read-only panel, independent), S4 (probe requires S1), S2 (UI consumer of S1).
mock_resolution_plan: No temporary mocks are introduced. S2 and S4 consume S1's FailedWelcomesAPI directly via import; because S1 is implemented first (story_order position 3), no stub is needed at integration time. Unit tests in S2 and S4 may use in-process fakes of the IDB functions (vitest mocks) — these are test fixtures, not tracked temporary mocks.

seams.data: Failed-welcome IDB records and DOM event notification

invariants: Records are unique by giftWrapEventId — re-inserting the same ID MUST overwrite, not duplicate (AC-LOG-3)
appendFailedWelcome dispatches notestr:failed-welcomes-changed on window after every write (AC-LOG-4)
pruneOlderThan dispatches notestr:failed-welcomes-changed after any records are removed (AC-LOG-4)
loadFailedWelcomes with { since: T } MUST return only records where recordedAt >= T

stories.name: identity-transparency-panel

stories.name: signin-time-probe
stories.title: Signin-time probe and one-time invitation banner
stories.description: Add a background one-shot probe to `src/marmot/client.tsx` that runs after the provider's critical init path completes. The probe fetches 14-day kind-1059 gift wraps, compares against loaded groups and failed-welcome records, and shows an inline banner if the gap is material. Gates on lastProbeAt in the notestr-identity IDB store to run at most once per 24 hours.
stories.notes: Probe MUST NOT block setState({ loading: false }) — it runs as a background IIFE after that call. Banner uses the inline aria-live pattern from DevicesTab.tsx:274-288, not a toast. lastProbeAt is stored under key 'lastProbeAt' in the notestr-identity IDB store. Unit test must cover: probe runs when lastProbeAt is absent; probe runs when lastProbeAt < now - 24h; probe does NOT run when lastProbeAt is fresh (AC-OBS-3). client.test.ts exists on disk but may need new test blocks — it is a modification, not a new file.
